MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 21

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 9

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 5

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
